source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify RAM Disk Configuration defaults and persistence of approved non-default controls without reserving unsafe memory, overwriting or exposing image data, changing the intended boot/recovery path or destabilizing the OS.
original_method: Manually load BIOS defaults, compare named RAM-disk fields with SPEC, apply a bounded size/source/image/boot matrix, save/reboot, verify persistence plus memory reservation, device/image identity and approved boot/recovery behavior.
manual_activity: An engineer must operate and visually accept RAM Disk firmware fields and observe firmware boot/recovery selection. Automated memory-map and image metadata collection is supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Named RAM Disk fields, allocation semantics and SPEC defaults
Approved sizes, source type, image digest/metadata and expected boot behavior
Minimum usable-memory limit, workload exclusion and no-production-data confirmation
Known-good local boot, independent console/OOB and cleanup/recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random, reserve excessive memory or select an unapproved image/source.
Do not create, mount, overwrite or persist writes to RAM-disk images unless a separate approved write plan exists.
Use an immutable non-production image with a recorded digest and exclude credentials or sensitive data.
Protect minimum usable memory, local recovery boot and independent console/OOB access.
Stop on unexpected memory loss, wrong image/device, data exposure, boot failure, OS instability or management loss.
Restore the approved final state; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only firmware/OS memory maps, total/usable/reserved memory, UEFI boot entries, RAM-disk device and image public metadata/digest, boot logs and BMC health.
Compare approved expected deltas without mounting or writing the image.
Do not drive BIOS, build/modify images, change boot entries or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve fields, sizes, source/image, memory limit, boot expectation and recovery.
Perform and capture default-first and bounded non-default firmware phases and observe approved boot behavior.
Interpret memory/image/boot evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; OS tmpfs/ramdisk creation is a different layer and not an equivalent substitute.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the firmware method and add version-recorded read-only memory-map, UEFI boot, device/image metadata and health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random remains source text only.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each firmware field to reserved-memory delta, exact immutable image digest and boot/recovery effect; verify default, persistence and final states with read-only memory-map and boot evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact RAM Disk firmware implementation, memory population and approved UEFI image format.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, OS/kernel, bootloader/image build and evidence-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform RAM Disk/UEFI boot documentation and approved recovery-image guidance.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random changes with explicit size/source/image scenarios and no-write image handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves defaults/persistence and adds usable-memory, image provenance and recovery-path coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Fields, size, image digest, boot expectation, memory floor and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS memory reporting may include reservations differently; firmware and OS maps must be reconciled.

project_override_considerations: A project may select named sizes, image sources and boot scenarios. Results must state excluded image types, sizes and recovery paths and cannot claim general RAM-disk support.
expected_evidence: Platform identity, field/default/size matrix, image digest, usable-memory limit and recovery
Baseline memory maps, UEFI boot entries, image metadata and health
Load Default captures plus SPEC and memory/boot comparison
Non-default captures, persistence and exact reservation/image/boot deltas
Approved final state, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The default-first and persistence lifecycle agrees with the criteria. Exact size, source and image are project readiness inputs, not contradictory facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The RAM Disk configuration lifecycle is clear. Missing image, size or recovery prevents a run but does not permanently block the master case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual firmware operation and adds memory-reservation, image-provenance and no-write safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its memory-map and boot evidence while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates firmware acceptance from read-only evidence and rejects OS ramdisk creation as a substitute.

review_improvement: Prevents a persisted value from being accepted when usable memory falls below the approved floor, the wrong image is selected or recovery is stranded.
independent_technical_reasoning: Core acceptance requires interactive firmware configuration and observation of its boot path. Automated memory/image evidence cannot perform that manual firmware work, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat RAM Disk changes, image selection, boots or recovery after memory, image, boot or management anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
